objective: Reusable high-fidelity 3D tool catalog for humans, animals, mecha, props and environments. Research-verified metadata only; no models redistributed.

items.name: Microsoft TRELLIS.2
items.hardware: NVIDIA CUDA GPU >=24 GB VRAM, Linux per upstream tests
items.notes: High-detail textured meshes and PBR maps; generated mesh is not guaranteed animation-ready or anatomically correct.

items.name: Tencent Hunyuan3D 2.1
items.license_scope: custom territory and redistribution terms; not Apache/MIT
items.hardware: CUDA GPU; upstream reports 10 GB shape, 21 GB paint, 29 GB combined
items.notes: Strong shape and PBR option; do not auto-pull weights or redistribute without license review.

items.name: MakeHuman MPFB 2
items.license_scope: independently sourced clothing/third-party assets may differ
items.hardware: CPU Blender 4.2+; test in Blender 5.2 pipeline
items.notes: Parametric human with built-in eyes, skin, clothing and rigs; realism requires custom textures and artistic refinement.

items.name: UniRig
items.license_scope: model weights and datasets separately verified before distribution
items.notes: Predict skeleton and skin weights for diverse shapes; review knees, tails, wings and mesh deformation.

items.name: Blender Studio CloudRig
items.license_scope: source addon; generated assets retain their own licenses
items.hardware: Blender 5.0 listed; verify 5.2 behavior before unattended install
items.notes: Advanced controller rig built from a metarig; not a 3D geometry generator.

items.name: Blender Studio Rain Character Rig
items.license_scope: attribution required; custom scripts embedded in .blend need cautious execution
items.notes: Professional example of skinning, face controls and IK; not a generic commercial character generator.

items.name: Instant Meshes
items.license_scope: source software; input model copyright remains unchanged
items.hardware: Native GUI, manual guided topology; binaries vary by OS
items.notes: Turn dense scans/sculpts into quad-oriented mesh; additional manual loops needed around joints.

items.name: Material Maker
items.notes: Create metallic/roughness/normal textures and procedural surface detail.

items.name: Poly Haven
items.license: CC0 (assets); live API has separate ToS
items.license_scope: live API use asks source acknowledgement and User-Agent; do not mirror whole catalog
items.hardware: No GPU to query or download; Blender import as needed
items.notes: Photoscanned props, HDRIs and PBR materials improve realism. Blender Online library currently targets Blender 5.3+, use API in 5.2.

items.name: ambientCG
items.license_scope: confirm per-asset licensing before public redistribution
items.notes: PBR surface textures and decals for metal, skin-adjacent materials, stone and wood.

items.name: Smithsonian Open Access 3D
items.license_scope: CC0 icon/metadata required for each download, others excluded
items.hardware: No GPU to download; high-resolution scans need remesh for game
items.notes: Accurate natural-history scans, fossils and museum objects; scans are mostly static and not animation-ready.

items.name: glTF-Transform
items.license_scope: program license only; imported asset license remains
items.notes: Inspect, resize textures and compress GLB for web. Always check appearance and animation after lossy changes.

items.name: Khronos glTF Validator
items.license_scope: official glTF 2.0 syntax/specification validator; no license transfer to assets
items.notes: Detect invalid accessors, animations, PBR usage and GLB structural problems.

items.name: NVIDIA SimReady Central
items.license_scope: OpenUSD portal is not a blanket CC0 library; review each file license
items.hardware: Varies; USD tooling may be needed
items.notes: Potential joints, collision and physical material reference for mech/city simulations.

items.name: Tencent ARC Pixal3D
items.license: MIT (project code and checkpoints) plus third-party terms
items.license_scope: Third-party dependencies and image-rights/consent need independent review (NOTICE).
items.hardware: CUDA GPU; follows TRELLIS.2 setup, low_vram option exists but no confirmed universal minimum
items.notes: SIGGRAPH 2026 pixel-aligned image-to-3D with PBR and multiview inference; candidate for side-by-side quality tests.

items.name: Meta SAM 3D Body
items.license_scope: Code and weights are not MIT/CC0; check distribution/use rules and checkpoint access.
items.hardware: GPU inference, see official INSTALL.md; not tested on GitHub CPU
items.notes: Single-image human body/hand/foot shape and pose recovery; research reference, not a ready-made photorealistic character generator.

items.name: Meta SAM 3D Objects
items.license_scope: Check checkpoints, source and derivative distribution conditions; 3DAO evaluation set is CC-BY-NC, not CC0.
items.hardware: GPU inference; not installed here; some outputs are Gaussian splats requiring conversion
items.notes: Reconstruct 3D objects/layout from real cluttered photos; not inherently a clean retopologized GLB.
